text:
elaine (seceng): Quick heads-upplanning an admin entitlement cleanup next Tue 10am PT. Goal: surface ownerless admin bindings, reconcile KMS grants, and validate svcacct activity. Keeping a conservative manual-approval flow.

mike (sre): +1. can you paste the ownerless query?

elaine (seceng): running against entitlement_view: 
```
SELECT resource, role, member, last_seen FROM entitlement_view
WHERE role ILIKE '%admin%' AND (owner IS NULL OR owner='') AND last_seen < '2023-01-01'
```
Primary checks: owner metadata, last_seen, kms_grant_count, recent auditlog entries.

samir (infra): found 6 prod KMS keys with grants but no owner tag. i'll map to services and add links to the GH ticket.

jordan (ops): @samir please include the exact iam members so we can stage removal commands. i'll run during the window.

samir (infra): remediation plan (staging first):
```
# grant ops temp admin
aws kms put-key-policy --key-id alias/prod-ml --policy file://temp-ops-policy.json
# revoke orphan member
aws kms revoke-grant --key-id arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123:key/abc --grant-id 9876543210
```

audit-bot: Note: created ticket 'entitlement-cleanup-2026-05' and notified listed owners.

elaine (seceng): action items:
- samir: full owner attribution for prod keys by EOD Fri
- jordan: outreach and record owner responses Mon
- mike: prepare rollback runbook and staging smoke tests
- all: review rows in https://tiny.example/entitlement-sheet

mike (sre): rollback snippet (only if service impaired):
```
# re-add grant
aws kms create-grant --key-id arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123:key/abc --grantee-principal arn:aws:iam::123:role/old-service --operations Encrypt Decrypt
```

samir (infra): Q: should we treat model-serving svcaccts as whitelisted permanent accounts? worried about accidental key revocation during high-traffic experiments.

elaine (seceng): yes, model-serving svcaccts are on the whitelist. we'll cross-check against 'critical-services' and escalate any unmatched entries.

jordan (ops): i'll standby for the window and have logs streaming. ping me @jordan if anything looks off.

elaine (seceng): policy: if audit logs show zero usage in 180 days AND no owner, we flag for outreach but do NOT auto-delete. manual approval required for removal.

mike (sre): i'll open PR with discovery + remediation scripts and link here.

samir (infra): linked PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/404 (discovery + safe-remediation).

elaine (seceng): final runbook posted Friday. window Tue 10-12 PT. document everything in the ticket.

audit-bot: Checklist updated added 'owner-evidence' requirement to the ticket.

jordan (ops): :thumbsup:
